note: CSP `inferred_real_class` remains the solver output; this sidecar is the override authority. Consumers: sidecar resolved > CSP > synthetic. A non-resolved entry is an explicit rejection of the CSP owner for that body (owner-unusable/unresolved), not a fall-through to CSP.
layout_check: offset-existence against class_layouts + e4 header; a candidate that fails is owner-unusable (failing offset/name recorded). Name-at-a-different-offset is a rewrite warning, not a layout fail.
